From b2d0efc4be7ed320e33eaa9b6dd6f3f6011ffb8e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Grzegorz Siwik <grzegorz.siwik@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2021 09:58:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] i40e: Fix parameters in aq_get_phy_register()

Change parameters order in aq_get_phy_register() due to wrong
statistics in PHY reported by ethtool. Previously all PHY statistics were
exactly the same for all interfaces
Now statistics are reported correctly - different for different interfaces

Fixes: 0514db37dd78 ("i40e: Extend PHY access with page change flag")
Signed-off-by: Grzegorz Siwik <grzegorz.siwik@intel.com>
Tested-by: Dave Switzer <david.switzer@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Nguyen <anthony.l.nguyen@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_ethtool.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_ethtool.c
index 96d5202a73e8..0e92668012e3 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_ethtool.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/i40e/i40e_ethtool.c
@@ -5480,7 +5480,7 @@ static int i40e_get_module_eeprom(struct net_device *netdev,
 
 		status = i40e_aq_get_phy_register(hw,
 				I40E_AQ_PHY_REG_ACCESS_EXTERNAL_MODULE,
-				true, addr, offset, &value, NULL);
+				addr, true, offset, &value, NULL);
 		if (status)
 			return -EIO;
 		data[i] = value;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `i40e_ethtool.c`**
   - The order of parameters in the function call to `i40e_aq_get_phy_register()` has been changed. 
   - The original call was:
     ```c
     i40e_aq_get_phy_register(hw, I40E_AQ_PHY_REG_ACCESS_EXTERNAL_MODULE, true, addr, offset, &value, NULL);
     ```
   - The modified call is:
     ```c
     i40e_aq_get_phy_register(hw, I40E_AQ_PHY_REG_ACCESS_EXTERNAL_MODULE, addr, true, offset, &value, NULL);
     ```
   - This change corrects the parameter order, which was causing incorrect statistics to be reported by ethtool.

### Relationships

- The modification in `i40e_ethtool.c` directly addresses a bug related to incorrect PHY statistics being reported for different interfaces. By changing the order of parameters in the function call, the patch ensures that the statistics are now reported correctly, resolving the issue that was introduced in a previous commit (identified by the fix tag `Fixes: 0514db37dd78`). This indicates a direct relationship between the parameter order and the accuracy of the reported statistics.
